gold: Drug-induced dermatomyositis secondary to ipilimumab therapy

selector.rationale: Photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption, diffuse erythema, and flagellate erythema are characteristic skin findings, along with prominent erythema at nailfolds and flat-topped papules over knuckles, which are more typical of dermatomyositis

rejected.label: Ipilimumab-induced dermatitis
rejected.why: Limited evidence and lack of specific findings unique to ipilimumab-induced dermatitis

rejected.label: Lupus-like syndrome
rejected.why: Insufficient evidence and lack of characteristic findings such as malar rash or oral ulcers
